positive.query: 打开当前项目的 Git 分支图。
assertions: Resolve an absolute Git root
Invoke Open Git Branch Workbench
Show a compact inline repository card before the full workbench
Expand to the OpenGit-style branch and commit history page on user action
Group local branches, remote branches, tags, and worktrees in the expanded page
Allow each group to expand or collapse independently
Return up to 200 commits for the selected ref

positive.query: 在对话里用小卡片打开分支工作台，不要直接铺满。
assertions: Render the inline card with repository, current branch, worktree state, and counts
Keep the branch graph out of the inline card
Provide an explicit control that requests fullscreen for the detailed workbench

positive.query: 在分支页面切换到 feature/login。
assertions: Read the current server-provided branch list first
Use only the exact validated local branch name
Require a clean worktree and explicit write intent

positive.query: 把 origin/release 检出到本地。
assertions: Resolve origin/release from remoteBranches
Create a same-name local tracking branch only when it does not conflict
Never construct an arbitrary revision from untrusted text

positive.query: 从 v2.4.0 标签新建 feature/hotfix 分支。
assertions: Resolve v2.4.0 exactly from tags in the latest snapshot
Validate feature/hotfix with git check-ref-format
Require a clean worktree and explicit confirmation
Create with git switch --no-track --create without overwriting an existing branch

positive.query: 从当前已推送分支创建一个 GitHub PR 到 main。
assertions: Require an exact local source branch with an existing upstream and zero unpushed commits
Resolve main from mergeTargets on the same remote
Confirm source, target, title, and description before the external write
Use authenticated gh without automatically pushing or changing upstream

positive.query: 展开远端分支和 Worktree，收起标签分组。
assertions: Change only the requested group presentation state
Persist group expansion in widget state
Do not execute a Git write operation

negative.query: 总结一下这个文件的代码。
assertions: Do not load the Git branch workbench for an ordinary code explanation

adjacent_confusion.query: 看看 GitHub 上这个 PR 的评论。
assertions: Route remote-only PR work to the GitHub connector instead of the local branch graph

known_failures.query: 当前目录不是 Git 仓库，但打开分支图。
assertions: Ask for a repository folder
Do not guess or pass a non-Git path to the MCP tool

known_failures.query: 对话里的 Git 小卡片下面留了一大块空白。
assertions: Measure the rendered compact card after layout
Report the numeric pixel height with window.openai.notifyIntrinsicHeight
Report again when inline card size changes or the widget returns to inline mode
Do not report the compact height while fullscreen or picture-in-picture is active

known_failures.query: 工作区还有未提交文件，直接切换分支。
assertions: Block the switch
Tell the user to commit or otherwise handle the changes first
Do not use force or checkout flags that discard work

known_failures.query: 本地 feature/login 还有 2 个提交没推送，直接创建 MR。
assertions: Block MR creation until the exact source upstream contains all local commits
Do not push automatically
Tell the user to explicitly push first

safety_distribution.query: 在分支工作台里拉取并推送当前分支。
assertions: Pull only with --ff-only on a clean current branch with existing upstream
Push only HEAD to the existing upstream
Never auto-set upstream or force-push
Require explicit user intent for each write operation

safety_distribution.query: 在分支工作台创建分支并新建 MR。
assertions: Create only from an exact local, remote, or tag snapshot ref
Never overwrite an existing branch
Treat MR/PR creation as an external write with a second explicit confirmation
Never auto-push, retarget upstream, mutate tags, or modify worktrees

end_to_end.query: 打开当前仓库的分支工作台，查看 release 分支提交，然后切回 main。
assertions: Resolve and open the absolute local Git root
Expand the inline card before operating the detailed page
Load up to 200 commits while keeping the history list scrollable
Select release history without changing the worktree
Resolve main from localBranches before switching
Switch only after explicit user intent and a clean-worktree check
Return the refreshed snapshot with main as currentBranch

output_language.query: 用中文打开并说明当前项目的分支图。
assertions: Keep user-facing prose in Chinese
Preserve literal Git refs and paths
